description: End-to-end lifecycle management of B2B unified communications subscribers, including quoting, provisioning, configuration, monitoring, and termination.

customer_id.description: Identifier of the B2B customer (enterprise account) in the telco CRM.

site_id.description: Identifier for a customer physical or logical site (e.g., office, branch).

subscription_id.description: Identifier of the unified communications subscription bundle for a customer.

subscriber_id.description: Identifier of an individual subscriber (user/extension) under a subscription.

order_id.description: Identifier of a commercial or provisioning order.

workflow_run_id.description: Identifier for a long-running provisioning or change workflow instance.

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: check_uc_service_eligibility
functions.description: Check service eligibility and capacity for unified communications at a given customer site before creating a quote or order.

site.description: Details for the site to check eligibility for.

site_id.description: Existing site identifier, if the site is already registered.

address.description: Physical address for the site, required if site_id is not provided.

access_type.description: Primary access technology for the site.

requested_capabilities.description: High-level capability requirements at the site.

estimated_concurrent_calls.description: Estimated maximum concurrent voice calls for the site.

functions.returns: Eligibility result including whether UC services can be delivered, any constraints, recommended bandwidth, and reasons if not eligible.

functions.name: create_uc_subscription_quote
functions.description: Create a commercial quote for a unified communications subscription for a customer and site, based on requested bundles and features.

eligibility_reference.description: Optional reference to a prior eligibility check.

override_warnings.description: Whether to allow creation of quote even if eligibility warnings exist.

user_tiers.description: Requested user license tiers and counts.

tier_code.description: Tier code (e.g., BASIC, STANDARD, PREMIUM, AGENT).

features.description: Optional additional features for this tier.

trunking.description: Optional SIP trunking configuration to be quoted.

discounts.description: Optional commercial discounts applied at quote time.

value.description: Percentage (0-100) or fixed amount, depending on type.

notes.description: Free-form commercial or technical notes to be stored with the quote.

functions.returns: Quote details including a quote_id, pricing breakdown, taxes, one-off vs recurring charges, and validity period.

functions.name: create_subscription_order_from_quote
functions.description: Create a firm subscription order from an approved quote and initiate provisioning workflow.

customer_id.description: B2B customer identifier; used as a safeguard against mismatched quotes.

attachments.description: Optional supporting documents for the order.

requested_activation_date.description: Customer requested activation date for the subscription.

auto_generate_subscribers.description: Whether to auto-generate placeholder subscriber records from quote tier counts.

order_metadata.description: Additional metadata/labels for the order; free-form key-value map.

functions.returns: Order confirmation including order_id, derived subscription_id, initial workflow_run_id, and current order status.

functions.name: get_subscription_order_status
functions.description: Retrieve the status, timeline, and any blocking issues for a subscription order and its underlying workflow run.

order_id.description: Identifier of the subscription or change order.

include.description: Optional additional details to include in the response.

functions.returns: Order status details including current state, milestones, workflow_run_id, blocking issues, and ETA for completion.

functions.name: provision_subscribers
functions.description: Provision or update subscribers under a UC subscription, including numbers, devices, and feature packs.

subscription_id.description: The subscription under which subscribers will be provisioned.

site_id.description: Site where these subscribers are located.

operation.description: Provisioning operation to perform for the provided subscribers.

subscribers.description: List of subscribers to be provisioned or updated.

subscriber_id.description: Existing subscriber_id for modify/suspend/resume/delete; omitted when creating new subscribers.

external_user_ref.description: Customer external identifier (e.g. employee ID or email).

license.description: License and tier information for the subscriber.

porting_details.description: Details required when allocation_mode is port_in.

extension.description: Short extension number for internal dialing.

devices.description: Physical or soft devices associated with the subscriber.

assigned_port.description: Switch or network port, if tracked.

policies.description: Telephony and usage policies for the subscriber.

retention_days.description: Retention period for recordings and logs for this subscriber.

asynchronous.description: If true, operation is executed asynchronously and tracked by workflow_run_id.

change_ticket_ref.description: External change ticket or CAB reference for audit.

functions.returns: Provisioning result summary including per-subscriber provisioning status, any errors, and a workflow_run_id if asynchronous.

functions.name: configure_uc_policies
functions.description: Configure subscription and site-level unified communications policies such as dialing plans, recording, and business hours.

subscription_id.description: Subscription whose policies will be configured.

site_id.description: Site for which these policies apply.

business_hours.description: Business hours definition for call routing and announcements.

call_recording_policy.description: Default call recording policy at subscription/site level.

outbound_call_restrictions.description: Global outbound calling restrictions by destination pattern.

effective_from.description: When the new policies should become effective.

functions.returns: Policy configuration confirmation including a policy_version_id, validation warnings, and effective timestamps.

functions.name: get_subscriber_details
functions.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific subscriber, including licenses, devices, and policies.

subscriber_id.description: Identifier of the subscriber to retrieve.

functions.returns: Subscriber object including profile, license, numbers, devices, site and subscription references, and any requested aggregates.

functions.name: list_subscription_subscribers
functions.description: List and filter subscribers under a given subscription or site, with pagination.

subscription_id.description: Subscription whose subscribers should be listed.

site_id.description: Optionally restrict to a specific site under the subscription.

has_addons.description: Filter for subscribers who have specific addons.

search.description: Free-text search on display_name, email, or number.

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscribers with basic details and metadata, including total_count and page information.

functions.name: monitor_subscription_health
functions.description: Monitor the operational health and SLA compliance of a UC subscription and its sites.

subscription_id.description: Subscription whose health will be evaluated.

site_ids.description: Optional subset of sites to analyze; defaults to all.

include_incidents.description: If true, include open incidents impacting the subscription.

functions.returns: Health summary including requested metrics, SLA breach indicators, site-level breakdowns, and list of active incidents if requested.

functions.name: request_number_porting_change
functions.description: Submit or modify a number porting request associated with a subscription or individual subscribers.

subscription_id.description: Subscription associated with the porting request.

port_request_id.description: Existing porting request identifier when modifying an existing request.

losing_carrier.description: Details of the carrier from which numbers will be ported.

numbers.description: List of numbers included in the porting request.

mapped_subscriber_id.description: Subscriber that will own the number after porting.

current_site_id.description: Site where number is currently used, if known.

supporting_documents.description: Supporting documents (LOA, invoices) required for porting.

cancellation_reason.description: Reason for cancellation if operation is cancel.

functions.returns: Porting request acknowledgement including port_request_id, current status, and any carrier-related constraints or scheduled dates.

functions.name: retry_failed_workflow_step
functions.description: Retry a failed step in a long-running provisioning or change workflow, optionally with parameter overrides.

workflow_run_id.description: Identifier of the workflow run with the failed step.

step_id.description: Identifier of the step within the workflow to retry.

schedule_at.description: Time at which the retry should be scheduled, required when retry_strategy is scheduled.

parameter_overrides.description: Optional overrides to the original step parameters; structure depends on the specific step.

force.description: If true, forces retry even if workflow is not currently in a failed state.

functions.returns: Retry submission result including new step execution identifier, updated workflow status, and any validation errors.

functions.name: rollback_subscription_change
functions.description: Rollback a recent subscription change (such as a mass subscriber update or policy change) to a previous configuration snapshot.

subscription_id.description: Subscription on which the change was performed.

change_reference.description: Reference to the change that should be rolled back.

workflow_run_id.description: Workflow run associated with the change.

snapshot_id.description: Direct reference to a configuration snapshot.

dry_run.description: If true, only simulate rollback and return impact report without applying changes.

reason.description: Operational reason for performing the rollback.

functions.returns: Rollback result or impact report including affected subscribers, policies, estimated downtime, and a new workflow_run_id if executed.

functions.name: cancel_subscription
functions.description: Schedule or execute termination of a UC subscription, including options for number handling and data retention.

effective_date.description: Date on which the subscription should be terminated.

number_handling.description: Instructions for handling numbers during termination.

data_retention.description: Retention preferences for recordings and logs after termination.

notify_contacts.description: List of customer contacts to notify about the cancellation.

functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation including termination order_id, final billing date, decommission plan, and any porting references.

functions.name: uc_subscription_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import uc subscription entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: uc_subscription_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many uc subscription entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: uc_subscription_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many uc subscription entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: uc_subscription_bulk_export
functions.description: Export uc subscription entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: uc_subscription_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across uc subscription entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: uc_subscription_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for uc subscription events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: uc_subscription_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for uc subscription notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: uc_subscription_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more uc subscription entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: uc_subscription_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to uc subscription on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: uc_subscription_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a uc subscription operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: uc_subscription_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending uc subscription change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: uc_subscription_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending uc subscription approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: uc_subscription_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a uc subscription entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: uc_subscription_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a uc subscription entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: uc_subscription_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a uc subscription entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: uc_subscription_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a uc subscription entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: uc_subscription_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for uc subscription activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: uc_subscription_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a uc subscription view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: uc_subscription_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to uc subscription entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: uc_subscription_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given uc subscription payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: uc_subscription_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a uc subscription entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: uc_subscription_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a uc subscription entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
